`spec`. The rules for a scene changed at stage 6 into a scene without a root panel have no test, nor does a scene change with an empty `panels`: `Top` acting as `Root` there, with clear stack on (`open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/shortcut-core.md:41`, `shortcut-core.md:60`), and the stack that the new scene's start handling opened when `panels` is empty (`shortcut-core.md:66`, `shortcut-core.md:67`). All `plain` rows of `test-data/data/tables/shortcut.csv:28` to `:31` have `stack` `Root`, and each test that uses them starts in `SCENE_PLAIN` (test_stack.gd:69, test_empty_panels.gd:22, test_open_operation.gd:41), so stage 6 is skipped. The rows with an empty `panels` (`root_empty`, `top_empty`, `plain_empty`) are also used only from their own target scene. Run path: change `client/godot/core/shortcut_core/shortcut_core.gd:129` to `row.stack != GameData.ShortcutStack.TOP and root_key == ""`, so that a `Top` row into a scene without a root panel opens on the stack from `on_start`, and no test has such a row, so no test fails. The current code follows the spec; only the test is missing. This exists before the range and is unrelated to it

Stage 7 does not reach the root item when the root panel key is also higher on the stack, so the stack at stage 9 differs from `open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/shortcut-core.md:66` (`panels` on top of the root item, or one root item). The cause is in the spec: stage 7 (`shortcut-core.md:59`) calls `UICore.close_panels_to` with the root panel key, and `open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/ui-core.md:183` sets its destination to the topmost item with that key and returns `true` without a transition when that item is the current panel. `open_panel` pushes a second item with the root key when the current panel is another panel (`ui-core.md:163`, `ui-core.md:164`). A `Top` row whose `panels` has the root panel, or a `Root` row whose `panels` is R, B, makes such a stack. Reproduced on a scratch copy: from `start_at(SCENE_ROOT, [PANEL_A, PANEL_R])` the stack is r,a,r; `navigate` of `root_c` returns `true` with stack r,a,r,c (expected r,c), and `navigate` of `root_r` returns `true` with stack r,a,r (expected r). The direction of the fix needs a spec decision: a `UICore` way to return to the root item, or a rule that forbids the root panel key in `panels`

All `ShortcutCore.release()` calls of `client/godot/core/shortcut_core/tests/test_release.gd` and `test_lifecycle.gd` run while the module waits on an operation or while no move runs.
